objective: server/services/russell/routing.ts (~L109 project name +60, ~L125 layer name +30) uses lower.includes(name), so a project named 'Brain' scores on 'let's brainstorm pricing for Deal Dispatch', 'Cash' on 'cashflow', 'V4' on 'V45', making routing ambiguous or wrong. Fix: replace both includes with a word-boundary test on the escaped name, boundaries being non letter/digit: (?<![\p{L}\p{N}])name(?![\p{L}\p{N}]) with flags 'iu'. tests/russellNervousSystem.test.ts routes 'Hidden Venture' and 'Deal Dispatch' verbatim and must keep passing.
expectedOutcome: A project or layer is named only as a whole word.
nonGoals: Changing scores or the ambiguity rule

acceptanceConditions.statement: a name inside another word no longer scores, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
